cohort: The study included 96 patients with congenital heart disease who were admitted for the first time to the Intensive Care Unit of the Hospital da Crianca Santo Antonio/Irmandade da Santa Casa de Misericordia de Porto Alegre between August 2005 and July 2006.
finding: Complex heart disease was independently associated with an odds ratio of 5.19 for death, and deaths predominantly occurred before the patients reached 1000 days of life.
